text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I overwhelmingly vote for the Alps!! We 
can measure the angles of goat horns with 
a protractor!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I know not. Paris is what suits me best.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sure, the curvature of the Eiffel Tower 
ain't bad either—but! I gotta prioritize 
the goat's raw vitality!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey... What have you been talking about 
this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey Nakayama! You tell 'em too! Where do 
you think we should go on a trip?!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit of casual fun. Why don't you 
give it a try too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* A trip, huh. I don't care for it 
much, but if I had to pick—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! I'm gonna measure the 
curvature of that marimo with my own two 
hands, babyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A view like that... Sensei would probably 
love it too.
